description: For an elementary embedding \(h:M\to N\), the disjoint union of \(M\) and a separately labelled copy of \(N\setminus h(M)\) is in bijection with \(N\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Diagrams.copyEquiv.{u, v, w, w'} {L : FirstOrder.Language} {M : Type w} {N : Type w'}
  [L.Structure M] [L.Structure N] (h : L.ElementaryEmbedding M N) : M ⊕ { b // b ∉ Set.range ⇑h } ≃ N
